best: The pack protection path (fuse, back-to-back CHG/DSG FETs with gate resistors, zener and ESD caps) and the four-switch power stage read left to right like textbook drawings, with clear section titles and notes.
worst: USB sheet is huge with tiny text, mostly label-connected support parts and unbalanced empty regions, so the PD controller and charger require net-name tracing
Text collisions: J113/TP106 PACK_P labels overlap, R106/C105/FET_MID crowd the gauge VCC pins, C118 ref sits on its symbol, TS2/TS3 and stacked GND pin numbers overlap on U401/U405
Many parts float tied only by labels (cell/wire connectors grid, U405 CC caps, U402 EEPROM, decoupling groups 'for U401...' far from their pins), and the 3V3 sheet leaves most of the page empty
